question: The Panchayati Raj Institutions DO NOT exist in which of the following states as on June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nagaland** does not have Panchayati Raj Institutions as on June 2022.
 
• Panchayati Raj Institutions are a system of rural local self-government in India, enacted by the **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992**.
 
• They aim to build **democracy at the grassroots level** and were introduced to ensure local self-governance.
 
• While most states in India have implemented Panchayati Raj Institutions, some states like Nagaland have not adopted this system due to their unique administrative and local governance structures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act** was passed in 1992 and came into effect on **24th April 1993**, marking a significant step towards decentralization of power.
 
• It mandates the **establishment of Panchayats at the village, intermediate, and district levels **in states and Union Territories.
 
• The act also provides for the **reservation of seats **for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and women, ensuring inclusive participation in local governance.
 
• Despite the general implementation of Panchayati Raj Institutions, certain regions with special administrative structures, such as Nagaland, have not adopted this system.
 
• Nagaland follows a unique village governance system based on traditional customs and practices of its indigenous communities.
